title: Home Purchase Financing Deferment Fee — Deferral Risk Add-On for Returned Payments
content:
**Credit risk pricing note — deferments on Home Purchase Financing loans**

Where two or more returned-payment fees were charged on the loan in the 12 whole months before the signing date, the deferral risk add-on is 0.50 percentage points; where exactly one was charged in those 12 months, the deferral risk add-on is 0.25 percentage points. Where none was charged in those 12 months, there is no deferral risk add-on.

The add-on is added to the deferral rate, and the deferral charge is figured on that combined percentage of the scheduled installment, rounded half up to the cent. The returned-payment fees counted are the returned-payment fee entries on the loan's transactions, by the date each fee was charged.

| Returned-payment fees charged in the 12 whole months before signing | Deferral risk add-on |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.50 percentage points |
| exactly 1 | 0.25 percentage points |
| none | none |

*Hypothetical example.* A deferral rate of 1.00 percent with one returned-payment fee in the 12 months becomes 1.25 percent; on a scheduled installment of 705.00 with 2 installments deferred that is 17.625, rounded half up to 17.63.
